scope: Bounded follow-up of only Teraco Isando JB7 and IXcellerate Veshki MOS11. Seven fresh captures; zero admissions. Prior sources and accepted checkpoints unchanged.

baseline.alias_screen: All 186 complete feature properties screened for Teraco, Isando, Veshki, Вешки, Вёшки, IXcellerate, MOS11, JB7 and Автомобильн. Sole match is Teraco CT1 Rondebosch, an unrelated same-operator campus. Neither candidate identity is selected.

candidates.name: Teraco Isando Campus / JB7

findings.finding: The dated article says JB7 at Isando is expanding and forecasts 40 MW by late 2026. The relevant passage has no directly attributed operator, contractor or municipal observation and no primary supporting link. Reporter narration is not promoted into qualifying authoritative testimony.

The current operator sustainability page advertises a 2026 report but its visible construction statements concern the off-site Sediba solar plant and wind projects. They do not date JB7 physical work. The report request CTA failed with a non-retryable web safety error; no alternative retrieval, form submission or gate bypass was attempted.

The operator expressly names existing Isando constituents JB1, JB3 and JB5, with separate addresses and literal GPS coordinates. These are campus-constituent locators, not the new JB7 footprint. The old November 2024 JB7 release already places JB7 alongside them. No new JB7 lifecycle statement appears.
findings.locator_limits: Coordinates are explicitly labelled GPS but no explicit datum or numeric accuracy is provided. No selected CRS, geometry, boundary, measured accuracy or JB7-specific footprint is asserted.

successor_checks: Bounded original-site and date-specific searches recovered the old November 13, 2024 construction-start release and summer/late-2026 deadlines, not a new primary current-build or handover record.
The previously held August 27 MyBroadband reporter update remains after the August 20 cutoff. It was not recaptured.
JB5 completion in June 2025 and JB4 completion in August 2025 concern separate existing constituents; neither completes or refreshes JB7.
The March 31 information in the July 1 parent SEC filing remains portfolio-aggregate, not a site-specific JB7 observation. No portfolio subtraction was used.
missing_gates: Original dated operator, contractor or public-authority evidence observing actual JB7 physical work during May 22–August 20, 2026, with completion/cancellation successor checks.
Review and bind a campus-level constituent locator or exact JB7 locator, source CRS and isolated-fact reuse basis; do not present an existing constituent as the JB7 footprint.

candidates.name: IXcellerate Veshki Campus / MOS11

findings.finding: The original sponsor announcement schedules an August 7 festival and MOS11 tours at the new Veshki campus. This proves a planned event, not observed physical construction or actual operational handover. Sponsor and event dates are not a construction status date.

The operator festival page explicitly names the Veshki campus and MOS11 tours, supplies the exact event-campus address and links its named Yandex organization. TIEKTA is identified as the campus builder; a real jointly produced power module is described as an exhibition. The page is undated and remains a programme, so the module is not treated as installed or as dated active construction.
findings.address: Московская область, Мытищи, посёлок Вёшки, ТПЗ «Алтуфьево», проезд Автомобильный, стр. 3

findings.publisher: Yandex, as linked by the operator
findings.finding: A single ordinary credential-free fetch of the operator-linked share URL redirected to the named IXcellerate organization 21929516133. The body is a generic JavaScript map shell; only a shared viewport was recovered, not the organization's exact feature geometry. The viewport is explicitly unselected.

The original builder project index lists only an unrelated Tulachermet container data-center reference. It supplies no named Veshki physical milestone, installation date or handover. No generic construction-service description was substituted.

successor_checks: The November 24, 2025 original campus announcement and December 1 interview forecast a summer 2026 MOS11 first phase and 2027 start for MOS12; neither is refreshed by current crawl dates.

A third-party indexed mirror of the operator Telegram channel describes the festival retrospectively as an introduction day and discusses future campus changes. Exact original-post dates and content were not recovered, so neither construction nor completion is accepted from it.
The public operator Telegram URL returned a non-retryable web safety error and was not retried with another tool or route.
No actual dated MOS11 completion/cancellation or qualifying in-window construction statement was found in bounded searches. A tour is not presumed to mean an operational data center.
missing_gates: A dated original IXcellerate, TIEKTA, EGENERGO, municipal or inspection record observing physical MOS11 brownfield conversion during May 22–August 20, 2026, with actual successor review.
An exact organization feature, named campus point or parcel beyond the Yandex viewport; independently established CRS, unknown accuracy preserved, and reviewed reuse basis.

duplicate_screening.method: All 186 full geometries compared with four explicitly unselected diagnostic probes. Point distances use haversine; polygon and multipolygon containment includes holes, and nearest-edge screening uses a candidate-local equirectangular projection. This is regional screening only, not an accepted-geometry duplicate clearance.

rights: Research handoff contains isolated factual restatements, public source links and unselected screening coordinates, not third-party prose, images, maps or databases. No open license is inferred from public access. Raw captures remain in ignored tmp custody; map assets, session fields and sponsor/visitor personal details are not republished.
